title: Citation
description: One citation, in its JSON form. The closed set has three types: grounded (the record says it), inferred (our reading of records) and absent (the needle is in none of the records searched). Every citation names records of a source file in records/. An object with no 'type' is grounded, so the proposal deck's {source, locator} cites are grounded citations as they stand. In Markdown and in map prose a grounded citation is written [SRC locator]. Resolution, quotes, needles and the rules per element category are checked by bs.py check against citation-types.json.

sourceId.description: A source id: capitals, digits and hyphens, at most 12 characters. It is the file name of records/<id>.json. The same pattern as the document and proposal builders.

locator.description: A record locator or a span, in the grammar of the source's kind (citation-types.json > kinds). It never holds [ ] ; or double quotes, so it can sit inside a [ ] marker. Grounded and inferred citations need one, except in a proposal deck; an absent span may leave it out to search the whole source.

ref.description: A reference: a source id and a locator. No locator means the whole source, which only an absent span or a proposal cite may use.

grounded.description: Grounded: the record (or every record of the span) is the evidence. 'quote', when given, must occur verbatim in a resolved record.

inferred.description: Inferred: our reading, resting on the records in 'from'. No nesting: 'from' holds references only.

absent.description: Absent: the needle occurs in no record of the spans in 'in'. It proves a gap. Each span must hold at least one record.

optionalCites.description: A list of citations that may be empty (the category rules decide what is required).
